title: Yellowed Brown American Ground Beef Casserole
description: A classic American casserole featuring ground beef, shio-koji, and beurre-monte, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 or 70/30 lean to fat ratio works well

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the shio-koji and beurre-monte, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the frozen peas and carrots to the skillet and cook until thawed.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the milk and flour, cooking over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, the cheese sauce, and the salt and pepper, stirring until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
